bullets.text: Apple Backs Strong Encryption - **Apple** prioritizes end-to-end encryption, even withdrawing features in the UK to maintain security.
UK Users Face Delayed Features - **Apple** warns that tighter regulations may slow down feature rollouts for UK users.
Galaxy S25 FE Leaks Revealed - Real-life images of **Samsung's** Galaxy S25 FE showcase its AI features ahead of launch.
WhatsApp Status Gets Update - **Meta** introduces a Close Friends feature for WhatsApp Status, enhancing user privacy.
Apple's iPhone 17 Air Expected - The upcoming **iPhone 17** may adopt eSIM-only design, expanding its international feature set.
Google's Antitrust Ruling Impact - **Google** retains Chrome but faces new restrictions to curb anticompetitive practices.
Amazon Launches Lens Live - **Amazon** introduces Lens Live, an AI shopping tool that identifies products in real-time.
OpenAI Enhances ChatGPT Safety - **OpenAI** plans to route sensitive conversations to GPT-5, introducing new parental controls.
Waymo Expands Robotaxi Service - **Waymo** launches services in Denver and Seattle, testing autonomous tech in diverse weather.
Anthropic Raises $13B - **Anthropic** secures $13 billion in funding, boosting its valuation to $183 billion amid AI growth.
